protocol: One loss-only replacement on the unchanged context network and training plan: mean pitch BCE plus the sum of zero-bounded log-sum-exp over all true and all false pitches, then batch mean. Coefficient 1; no sweeps or refits. All existing gates and cutoff selection remain unchanged.

prospective_comparison.interpretation: Report exact, false and missing counts separately. Any single-pitch regression means the preservation objective is not achieved even if aggregate research gates pass. These comparisons do not relax or replace the existing gates.

training_plan_identity.encoding: SHA256 of decompressed JSON bytes; gzip timestamp excluded

stage: review passed; scoped commits and one dispatch next
bulk_policy: Collect small report once with server digest verified. Keep model and bulk predictions remote unless a named later diagnosis requires them.

validation.skip_reason: Fourteen Torch checks and one sklearn check run on GitHub before recorded fitting; no local installation.

focused_review.scope: Setwise loss, edge cases, unchanged previous objectives and stage gates, source isolation, bounded CPU workflow
focused_review.result: No material blockers. Record worker SHA and verify report GITHUB_SHA. Single-pitch preservation remains a separately reported acceptance condition.

next: Commit/push scoped source and worker, record exact SHAs, then dispatch once. Collect the small report only; preserve existing gates and report isolated-note preservation separately.
